[EN] Bearly Fashionable
[ES] Moda de oso
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I never expected to find a hot item like this. Is it talent? Is it fate?
[ES] Jamás esperé encontrar un artículo tan popular. ¿Es talento? ¿Es el destino?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I guarantee you that bear fur will dominate Allemantheian fashion.
[ES] Te garantizo que la piel de oso va a dominar la alta costura de Allemantheia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] {@linkcreature:30#200$$Plainstalker Bear} Fur
[ES] Piel de {@linkcreature:30#200$$Plainstalker Bear}
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt {@linkcreature:30#200#plainstalker bears} and collect their fur.
[ES] Caza {@linkcreature:30#200#plainstalker bears} y recolecta su piel.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the fur to {@linkcreature:230#1027$$Legan}.
[ES] Entrégale la piel a {@linkcreature:230#1027$$Legan}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to be of service."
[ES] Encantado de servir.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
